label: Transmission
agentGuide: Everything is POST /transmission/rpc with a JSON body {"method": "...", "arguments": {...}}; the answer has result ("success") and arguments. List: method torrent-get, arguments {"fields": ["id","name","status","percentDone","rateDownload","rateUpload","eta","totalSize","downloadDir"]} (add "ids": [..] for some). Add: torrent-add with {"filename": "magnet:?xt=..."} (or a URL; download-dir optional). Control: torrent-start, torrent-stop, torrent-remove ({"ids": [..], "delete-local-data": false}) — ask before deleting data. Overall numbers: session-stats; settings: session-get. The anti-forgery header is set by Allkin.
